explanation: The theorem states that the group-theoretic 'trace' `Tr σ c = ∑ h : G, σ h c` of a monoid homomorphism σ : G →* (A ≃+* A) is fixed by every σ g. Mathlib has no such trace-fixing statement: there is no `Tr` definition (grep for `def Tr`/`Tr_` finds nothing), and searching for lemmas about group sums being invariant under the group action found only the multiplicative analogue `Finset.smul_prod_perm` (Algebra/BigOperators/GroupWithZero/Action.lean, `g • ∏ h, h • b = ∏ h, h • b`) and `smul_finprod_perm`, with no additive/to_additive counterpart (`Finset.smul_sum_perm` does not exist). Also checked RepresentationTheory/Invariants.lean (averageMap_invariant, mul_average_left), GroupTheory/GroupAction/*, RingTheory/Invariant/*, Algebra/Group/Translate.lean (`sum_translate`, which is about additive groups), and the FixedPoints API: none contains this result. The library's own proof uses only the general bijection lemma `Fintype.sum_equiv` together with `map_sum` and the local lemma `σ_mul_apply`; those are generic ingredients (a permutation of the index set plus additivity), not a Mathlib declaration carrying this trace-fixedness content, so no duplicate or one-step special case was found.
